recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11103 unless CDS reopens the broader RiskAssessment modeling question in a new tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-11103 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for FHIR-core RiskAssessment. The DSTU2 ballot note asked whether relative risk was in the 80%, the commenter asked that a normalized risk be supported, and the accepted resolution said normalized risk score would be supported and the documentation updated to remove the balloting question.
initial_application: SVN 11387, imported as git commit de39c36babe215c48986f3c8edfacdb94459ac9b, was tagged #11102/#11103 and removed the RiskAssessment STU open-issues note plus the spreadsheet todo asking whether relativeRisk was in the 80%. The change retained RiskAssessment.relativeRisk support rather than adding a new element; later source refactoring moved the authoritative definition from spreadsheets into structuredefinition-RiskAssessment.xml.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition supports probability[x] as decimal, Quantity, or Range, qualitativeRisk, and relativeRisk as a decimal ratio to the general population, and riskassessment-notes.xml no longer contains the old STU open-issue note. FHIR-11102 was the neighboring method question handled by the same commit, FHIR-7769 is older no-change relative-risk background, and later FHIR-27875 probability Quantity/Range work is already reflected in current source.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build-scoped source already conveys the normalized/relative risk support and removed-ballot-question outcome requested by FHIR-11103, so this reconciliation published an empty audit commit.
